Kim / Rafael — forwarding Emma’s note (ACME_SOW.docx attached).

Quick ask: we need tight copy for the AWS offer product page and a short demo checklist for field. I sketched two hero options below — want your take and any trust-bullet language we can pull from their SOC2 summary. If possible, return with "hero final" and a ~3-bullet trust section by EOD so we can stage the listing draft.

Hero option A (concise):
- Redwood Inference: high-throughput LLM inference with predictable cost and enterprise controls.

Hero option B (use-case led):
- Run low-latency chat and scalable batch inference on demand — optimized for production latency and cost.

Trust bullets (draft):
- SOC 2 Type II: summary available — controls over security and availability.
- Dedicated support and onboarding: SLA-backed options for production rollouts.
- Enterprise-ready data handling: optional VPC/on-prem routing and KMS integrations.

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Offer page trust evidence & demo path — quick check

Priya — thanks for the forward. Quick edits/suggestions below and I attached a drafted hero/module doc. Also added a short "demo flow" checklist the sales team can follow.

Hero (final suggestion — combines A + B):
- Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference for low-latency chat and high-throughput batch, with predictable cost controls and enterprise security.

Trust bullets (3 short lines to appear under "Why Redwood"):
- SOC 2 Type II (summary available) — controls over security and availability.
- Option for VPC/private deployments and customer-managed KMS.
- SLA-backed Dedicated capacity and field onboarding.

Demo flow checklist (one-liner items):
- Confirm POC dataset + target latency/throughput metrics.
- Provision trial account and select model profile (we’ll provide a sample config).
- Run 48-hour load test + 24-hour latency sampling; collect cost report.
- Field debrief + next-steps (reserve or scale).

Rationale: keep hero compact but explicit about "latency" and "cost" — customers searching the marketplace often filter on performance keywords.

Attachments: marketplace-hero-v2.docx (hero + modular copy), evidence-binder-links.txt (links to SOC2 summary + PCI note)

On billing SKUs: Rafael, recommend surfacing: Trial (metered) and Dedicated (monthly commit) with a small footnote linking to the billing FAQ. Happy to mock the footnote if useful.

—Kimberly
